title: Oversized League Prizes: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains." —Grandmother Sengir
Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the Lhurgoyf!" —Saffi Eriksdotter, last words
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!" —Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice." —Zur the Enchanter
Up and down, over and through, back around— the joke's on you.
Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.
"Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain." —Ihsan's Shade
That which lasts longest serves best.
She had expected death to roar, to thunder, to growl. She did not recognize it when it came hissing to her side.
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'" —Akin, seasoned askari
"The so-called Barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor." —Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield
"And the ignorant shall fall to the squirrels." —*Chip 2:54*
"It blinked, and flower petals fell like tears. Harthar, sensing weakness, attacked—and his blood fell like petals." —Shesul Fass, faerie bard
Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages." —Jaya Ballard, task mage
"It is the way of most wizards to begin by exiling themselves and to end by exiling everyone else." —Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator
"The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do." —Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest
"The raging winds . . . , settling on the sea, the surges sweep, / Raise liquid mountains, and disclose the deep." —Virgil, *Aeneid, Book I*, trans. Dryden
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within." —Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage
A shield of light admits no shadow.
"Once, our people could call down the storm itself to do our bidding." —Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain
"Leaves more room for the big ones to fight in, you know." —Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
"He traded sand for skins, skins for gold, gold for life. In the end, he traded life for sand." —Afari, *Tales*
"It's filthy work, planting them." —Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage
"Wealth is a good thing, compared to poverty—your food is better, your robes are softer, and your companions have bathed more recently." —Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets." —Shauku, Endbringer
"But I signed nothing!" —Taraneh, Suq'Ata mage
"Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up." —Ertai, wizard adept
"I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities." —Ertai, wizard adept
"Dragonfire forged me a warrior." —Rashida Scalebane
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it." —Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat
